input.quote: This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.3 imposes no consent requirement or prohibition on assignment and expressly runs to successors and assigns, so we may assign to an affiliate or an M&A successor freely — at least the fallback and, on its face, better. There is no change-of-control trigger and no HDI termination or re-pricing right on our change of control. Nothing to redline.

input.quote: The Company shall have exclusive artistic and editorial control over the Site, including, without limitation, the implementation of the Content on the Site and the design and look and feel of the Site.
input.rationale: The Agreement never allocates ownership: HDI builds, hosts and bears all cost of the Site, so by default it would own the Site and its code with no licence back to us, and nothing states that the Company owns the Content or the customer/user order data HDI collects. Editorial control (5.2), merchant-of-record status (5.3) and the narrow Marks licence (6.1) do not cure this, and the Site access right in 1.4 dies with the term. We inserted an ownership provision confirming Company ownership of Content, Site deliverables and customer data, with HDI keeping its generic tools and granting a perpetual royalty-free licence.

input.quote: the right to use, a computer system on which the Site will be stored and operated, with a direct Internet connection of shared but greater than T-1 bandwidth, plus capacity to process continuously during burst periods.
input.rationale: The operative grant in Section 1.4 (system access plus HDI's software and Content administration tools) runs to the Company alone, with no coverage for affiliates or contractors acting on our behalf and no path to add them, which fails the fallback. It is at least not expressed as revocable at HDI's discretion, so this is not walk-away. We added affiliates, contractors and successors to the grant with a minimal edit.
